note: NECO Government round 7 (R46 top-up): onshore-offshore dichotomy; joint session; VP completes the term; underage voting; 2014 National Conference; indigene-settler question; Democracy Day moved to June 12; features of a state; committee system; political apathy; habeas corpus; criminal vs civil law; national honours; Oputa Panel; commission of inquiry; fuel subsidy; notice of election/timetable; campaign spending limits; run-off election; inconclusive and supplementary elections; service chiefs' confirmation; independent candidate; constituent assembly; Resident Electoral Commissioner; red chamber. Scanned against the whole Government pool (JAMB, WAEC and NECO stems).
